target.table_description: Consolidated Data Product - customer summary with segment classification and aggregated product/balance metrics built via 3-level CTE chain

columns.name: customer_segment
columns.description: Derived customer segment based on product count and balance thresholds

columns.name: total_products
columns.description: Total number of distinct products held by customer

columns.name: avg_balance
columns.description: Average balance across all customer accounts

code.content:
WITH cte_base AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    product_code,
    account_balance,
    account_status
  FROM fdp_uk_customer_db.customer_detail
  WHERE account_status = 'ACTIVE'
),
cte_enriched AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    product_code,
    account_balance,
    CASE
      WHEN account_balance >= 100000 THEN 'HIGH_VALUE'
      WHEN account_balance >= 25000 THEN 'MEDIUM_VALUE'
      ELSE 'STANDARD'
    END AS balance_tier
  FROM cte_base
),
cte_final AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT product_code) >= 5 AND MAX(balance_tier) = 'HIGH_VALUE' THEN 'PREMIER'
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT product_code) >= 3 THEN 'PREFERRED'
      ELSE 'CORE'
    END AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT product_code) AS total_products,
    CAST(AVG(account_balance) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS avg_balance
  FROM cte_enriched
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
INSERT INTO cdp_uk_analytics_db.customer_summary
SELECT
  customer_id,
  customer_segment,
  total_products,
  avg_balance
FROM cte_final
